checks.text: The page heading is "Running Log" and the empty state shows the text "No runs yet".

Clicking the button "Add run" opens a form. Filling the field labelled "Date" with "2024-01-15", the field labelled "Distance (km)" with "5.2", and the field labelled "Time (min)" with "28", then clicking "Save run" adds a row to the table containing "2024-01-15", "5.2 km", "28 min", and "5:24/km"; the text "No runs yet" is gone.
After adding the run from A2, clicking the button "Delete 2024-01-15" removes that row and the text "No runs yet" reappears.
With the run from A2 present, clicking the column header "Distance" sorts the table so the distance column is in descending order; the first data row shows "5.2 km".
After adding a second run with Date "2024-01-16", Distance "10.5", and Time "52", the table shows two rows; the row for "2024-01-16" displays "10.5 km", "52 min", and "4:57/km".
Clicking the tab "Chart" shows an SVG line chart with the text "Distance over time" and a data point labelled "5.2" for the run dated "2024-01-15".
Clicking the button "Export CSV" downloads a file whose first line is "date,distance_km,time_min,pace" and whose second line is "2024-01-15,5.2,28,5:24/km".
Typing "10.5" in the search box labelled "Search runs" filters the table to show only the row containing "10.5 km"; typing "zzz" shows the text "No runs match".
Reload keeps the run added in A2: after reloading, the table still contains a row with "2024-01-15", "5.2 km", "28 min", and "5:24/km".
